QuestionStmt.S: The period of S.H.M. of a particle is 16 second. The phase difference between the positions at $t = 2 \, \text{s}$ and $t = 4 \, \text{s}$ will be

Solution.S:
Given $T = 16$ s. Angular frequency: $$\omega = \frac{2\pi}{T} = \frac{2\pi}{16} = \frac{\pi}{8} \text{ rad/s}$$

Phase at $t = 2$ s: $\phi_1 = \omega t_1 = \frac{\pi}{8} \times 2 = \frac{\pi}{4}$

Phase at $t = 4$ s: $\phi_2 = \omega t_2 = \frac{\pi}{8} \times 4 = \frac{\pi}{2}$

Phase difference: $\Delta \phi = \phi_2 - \phi_1 = \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{4}$

Thus the correct option is C: $\frac{\pi}{4}$.
